title: So close to releasing Retro TV Emulator project.
author: RetroTVEmulator
selftext: cleaning up the last of the bugs, added in all project goals and testing the project as a whole, combining functions to save cost, refining how things are done to save cost, one feature and one bug at a time. I have to be close to done. my last bugs to clean up as of now is the occasional navigation bug (went one spot to far and i think i fixed this), the occasional disconnect in the navigation from combining all navigation into on function that controls the whole projects controls (i have not found anymore and did a successful test setting up the whole program from default never booted). and testing over and over on different computers looking for something to break. im sure there are one off bugs waiting to be found when something is finally activated that normally is not. oh and im still working on getting captions working on the .exe but thats just me not knowing how to setup its dependence properly yet. fingers crossed on my next build i got that sorted out.
